scope: Four OCR files. Adiparva1–237 plus Sabhaparva1–24 only; not the whole18-parva epic.
language: Kannada translation and Sanskrit text in Kannada script; modern commentary and editorial apparatus.
line_number_method: 1-based Python str.splitlines on UTF-8 text decoded from ZIP; audit copies match source bytes.

front_matter.title: Bibliographic and devotional front matter
front_matter.summary_en: Title, translator P. S. Sheshagiri Acharya, publisher Tattvasamshodhana Samsat at Palimaru Matha, publication project and credits; present credits, not story events.

front_matter.title: Blessing message 1
front_matter.summary_en: Pejavara message: epic study and the value of the publication, explicitly devotional endorsement.

front_matter.title: Blessing message 2
front_matter.summary_en: Adamaru message: epic study, teaching, publication and blessings.

front_matter.title: Blessing message 3
front_matter.summary_en: Devotional message connecting epic study and ethical life; retain as attributed introductory view.

front_matter.title: Blessing message 4
front_matter.summary_en: Sode/Vadiraja Matha message and blessings; retain as attributed introduction.

front_matter.title: The greatness of the Mahabharata
front_matter.summary_en: Devotional explanation of Vyasa and the epic through scriptural references; OCR contains duplication around this essay.

front_matter.title: On textual research
front_matter.summary_en: Northern and southern recensions, printed and manuscript witnesses, Tatparyanirnaya and the need for editorial choice.

front_matter.title: Lakshalankara and Vadiraja
front_matter.summary_en: Commentarial approach and the place of Vadiraja in this edition.

front_matter.title: Ancient manuscripts
front_matter.summary_en: Manuscript evidence used by the editors.

front_matter.title: Contributions of the eight mathas
front_matter.summary_en: Institutional preservation and support for the edition.

front_matter.title: Readings in palm-leaf manuscripts
front_matter.summary_en: Examples of variant readings; not new dramatic plot.

front_matter.title: Interpretive examples from Lakshalankara
front_matter.summary_en: Eighteen numbered examples and translator conclusion; lexical and theological issues should remain attributed commentary.

front_matter.title: About Adiparva
front_matter.summary_en: Edition numbers Adi1–237; contrasts218 and200 schemes. Explicitly repeats Puru genealogy as chapters63 and83. Notes Yayati-before-Dushyanta order, Parashara/Satyavati, Kaninka dispute and Draupadi interpretation.

front_matter.title: Publisher statement and acknowledgements
front_matter.summary_en: Purpose, translation method, lexical examples, doctrinal framing and credits to patrons, scholars, proofreaders and production contributors.

front_matter.title: The importance of the Mahabharata
front_matter.summary_en: Ethical, educational and cultural claims made by the introductory author; do not present sweeping claims as independently established facts.

front_matter.title: How to determine a sound reading
front_matter.summary_en: Introductory author explains the edition's criteria and opening invocation preference.

front_matter.title: Bhandarkar institute discussion
front_matter.summary_en: Acknowledges the critical-edition undertaking and describes disagreements from this edition's standpoint.

front_matter.title: Previous research and publications
front_matter.summary_en: Historical review of earlier edited/printed versions; individual names/dates require checking against scan before screen use.

front_matter.summary_en: Commentarial witnesses.

front_matter.title: Problems of northern readings
front_matter.summary_en: Edition-specific textual criticism, not a universal verdict on all traditions.

front_matter.title: New contributions to Sanskrit and conclusion
front_matter.summary_en: Editorial rationale and concluding attribution to Bemmatti Venkateshacharya.
